name: optcatalog_mine_iterator_next
description: OptCatalog_MineIterator::Next advances the global mine iterator cursor to the next runtime instance and returns the new cursor.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog mine-runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2940 validates reading g_OptCatalog_MineIteratorCursor, returning null without change when it is null, otherwise advancing to cursor->next, storing the new cursor globally, and returning it.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies advancing from first to second runtime instance and repeated null-at-end behavior.
